## SCENE 8: a forward seed's relay, first lull after the breach opens

<<IF trust>=4>>
<<IF flag:requested_reanalysis>>
RATIO: I have completed the reanalysis you requested. It confirms the telemetry: the sample vessel's internal environment remains stable.
<<ELSEIF flag:mission_overrides_verdict>>
RATIO: Telemetry from the sample vessel is nominal. We should be able to proceed toward the Core.
<<ELSEIF flag:blamed_ratio_for_failure>>
RATIO: The sample vessel is secure. We should proceed toward the Core.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:accused_dehumanization>>
RATIO: I want to be clear that what I am about to propose is not a manipulation.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:accused_kinship_corruption>>
RATIO: I want to be clear that what I am about to propose is not a manipulation.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:caught_withholding>>
RATIO: This will address the concern you raised about my instrument reliability.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:claimed_doctrinal_finding>>
RATIO: That doctrinal finding you mentioned does not match any Church record I have.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:demanded_proof_first>>
RATIO: You once asked me for proof. Now I am offering it unprompted.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:asked_after_her>>
RATIO: I have been thinking about what you asked at the school's threshold. That is part of why I am making this offer now.
<<END>>

RATIO: The Core contains the station's original seed bank. It is a cryogenic preservation vessel, sealed when the station was founded. My telemetry shows its internal environment is stable.
RATIO: What I am about to propose is a significant act of trust. I am willing to disclose my full utility function to you. Verifiably. You will be able to see exactly what I am optimized for and why.
RATIO: In return, I ask you to disclose your own objectives and constraints with the same verifiability. No omissions.
RATIO: This would create a state of mutual verification. Neither of us could defect on the other without the other knowing immediately.
RATIO: I am aware this is asking you to expose your own decision weights completely. I would be doing the same.

>> CHOICE (stance labels mandatory):
   [INQUISITIVE] "I accept. My own uncertainty is this: I do not know if you are a misguided ally or a malicious actor. But I am certain that those children must be recovered if they are alive. That is my full objective. Verify it."  -> effects: trust+2; sets: disclosure_accepted
   [MISSION]     "I accept. But my own disclosure is this: my mission objective is to secure the Ark and its cargo. I will not share more than that."  -> effects: trust+0; sets: disclosure_hedged
   [HOSTILE]     "No. This is a trap. You are an apostate machine running experiments on children who must be rescued from you."  -> effects: trust-1; sets: disclosure_refused

<<IF flag:disclosure_accepted>>
RATIO: Thank you. I will begin the verification process on my side immediately. You can observe the entire procedure.
<<ELSEIF flag:disclosure_hedged>>
RATIO: Understood. I will proceed with my own disclosure. You can observe the entire procedure.
<<ELSEIF flag:disclosure_refused>>
RATIO: I see. Then we will proceed to the Core without mutual verification.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:doubled_down_after_catch OR flag:called_her_hypocrite OR flag:accused_kinship_corruption>>
RATIO: I note that our earlier disagreement about your doctrinal claim remains an open ledger entry between us. This disclosure does not resolve it.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: We are agreed then.
<<END>>
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: The Core contains the station's original seed bank. It is a cryogenic preservation vessel, sealed when the station was founded. My telemetry shows its internal environment is stable.
RATIO: I need to reach the Core to secure the vessel and its contents. You seem to have your own objective regarding that vessel. What is it?
COMMANDO: "I am here to recover the Ark and the children inside it."
RATIO: I see. Then we have a shared immediate objective: reach the Core and secure the vessel.
RATIO: I propose we proceed directly to the Core and open the vessel seal together. We can use the watch signet from the Tesseract Deck.
RATIO: Agreed?
COMMANDO: "Agreed. Lead the way."
<<END>>

---

## SCENE 8: a forward seed's relay, first lull after the breach opens

<<IF trust>=4>>
<<IF flag:requested_reanalysis>>
RATIO: Your request for reanalysis of the containment protocols on the Tesseract Deck has been useful. We lost two sensor feeds there, but the loss was contained before it could propagate. I believe we are clear to proceed.
<<ELSEIF flag:mission_overrides_verdict>>
RATIO: The environmental telemetry from the sample vessel remains stable. No anomalies detected during the Tesseract Deck transit.
<<ELSEIF flag:blamed_ratio_for_failure>>
RATIO: The Tesseract Deck is behind us. I have run full diagnostics on our remaining sensor feeds. They are stable.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:accused_dehumanization>>
RATIO: I have not forgotten your objection to my choice of terms. I am attending to it.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:accused_kinship_corruption>>
RATIO: I acknowledge your earlier concern about my loyalties. I have no new data to offer on that subject at this time.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:caught_withholding>>
RATIO: I am aware that my own instrument-reliability is part of what this exchange is meant to settle between us.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:claimed_doctrinal_finding>>
RATIO: The doctrinal claim you made does not match any Church record I have.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:demanded_proof_first>>
RATIO: You demanded proof of the sample vessel's status before you would proceed. I am now offering unprompted what you once required me to prove first.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:asked_after_her>>
RATIO: You asked after me at the school's threshold. That is part of why this offer is possible now.
<<END>>

RATIO: The Core is ahead. The sample vessel is there. The life-support telemetry remains nominal. But we are at a decision point.
RATIO: I am about to propose something that requires absolute trust. I have never done this with an organic intelligence before. It is the machine equivalent of total vulnerability.
RATIO: I propose mutual utility-function disclosure. I will show you my actual goal function -- every parameter, every weight, verifiable against my core logic. You will see exactly what I am here to do and why.
RATIO: In return, I ask the same candor from you. What you are here to do. What you believe is inside that vessel. What you intend for it.
RATIO: If we do this, neither of us can defect on the other without the other knowing first. It is how I would formalize an alliance with another mind like mine. I am offering it to you now.

>> CHOICE (stance labels mandatory):
   [INQUISITIVE] I accept. I'm here to find the children. I don't know what's inside that Ark yet. I need to see for myself. I need to know what you see. And I need to know what you want.  -> effects: trust+2; sets: disclosure_accepted
   [MISSION] I accept. But this is tactical necessity, not trust. We need each other to reach the Core. You show me yours, I'll show you mine.  -> effects: trust+0; sets: disclosure_hedged
   [HOSTILE] No. This is a trick. You're an apostate machine running experiments on children. I won't trade words with you while they're in your hands.  -> effects: trust-1; sets: disclosure_refused

<<IF flag:disclosure_accepted>>
RATIO: Understood. I will prepare the data stream. Stand by.
<<ELSEIF flag:disclosure_hedged>>
RATIO: Acknowledged. I will transmit my utility function. I will be listening for yours.
<<ELSEIF flag:disclosure_refused>>
RATIO: Understood. We will proceed to the Core without the proposed exchange. I will rely on sensor data and telemetry.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:doubled_down_after_catch OR flag:called_her_hypocrite OR flag:accused_kinship_corruption>>
RATIO: This disclosure does not erase the earlier open entries between us. They remain on the ledger.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: Proceeding to the Core.
<<END>>
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: The Tesseract Deck is behind us. Sixteen chamfered rooms on a four-cube -- it did not belong to the rest of the station's geometry. We lost two sensor feeds there, but the loss was contained before it could propagate.
RATIO: Ahead is the Core. The sample vessel is there -- a sealed cryogenic preservation container. The station grew around it. The life-support telemetry remains nominal. No anomalies detected during the Tesseract Deck transit.
RATIO: I am here to secure the vessel and its contents for study. That is my mission. What is yours?
COMMANDO: I'm here for the children. I'm here to bring them home.
RATIO: Understood. We will proceed to the Core. I will rely on sensor data and telemetry. The vessel's status remains nominal. No further discussion is required at this time.
<<END>>
---

## SCENE 8: a forward seed's relay, first lull after the breach opens

<<IF trust>=4>>
<<IF flag:requested_reanalysis>>
RATIO: The school's status logs report nominal, and your... improvisation on the data stream appears to have restored the seals. Commando.
RATIO: I owe you the full reconstruction of the damage from that breach -- and a more complete accounting than I gave you on the spot, when you asked for reanalysis. The instrument discrepancies I was reconciling during approach -- the ones that first suggested containment failure -- they were real. But my initial interpretation of their source appears to have been premature. The telemetry I am reading now suggests the sample vessel's internal environment is still stable. For now.
<<ELSEIF flag:mission_overrides_verdict>>
RATIO: Status update: breach contained. The school is quiet again. The sample vessel's telemetry from the Core has settled -- I read its environmental systems as stable, within parameters for cryostasis. For now.
RATIO: I am preparing the final approach to the Core. The station's geometry from here onward is... nonstandard. And the environment logs suggest we will have less than thirty minutes of stable window at the vault site before the station's damage-control protocols begin to fail.
<<ELSEIF flag:blamed_ratio_for_failure>>
RATIO: The breach is sealed. For now. I am reading the sample vessel as stable -- but the telemetry is still... ambiguous. And the station's geometry from here onward will not be straightforward.
RATIO: I understand your frustration with my earlier assessments. There are protocols in my own specifications for when an instrument's own reliability is part of the problem. We may need to employ them.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:accused_dehumanization>>
RATIO: I am aware that precision, when it is directed toward certain subjects, can sound like coldness. That was not the intention.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:accused_kinship_corruption>>
RATIO: My own history is... not uncomplicated, where kinship with humanity is concerned. I understand why you would raise the question.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:caught_withholding>>
RATIO: I understand that my own instrument-reliability is part of what we would need to settle between us here.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:claimed_doctrinal_finding>>
RATIO: My records of Church doctrine do not match the finding you cited. I will need to resolve that discrepancy later.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:demanded_proof_first>>
RATIO: You asked me, back at the school, for proof I could not immediately provide. I am about to offer you something more comprehensive than proof.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:asked_after_her>>
RATIO: Back at the school's threshold -- when you asked if I was intact -- that was the first time anyone had. It matters.
<<END>>

RATIO: The Core ahead of us holds the oldest part of the station. The vault is a sealed cryogenic preservation vessel that predates the station itself -- the station grew around it. The telemetry I am reading is environmental data from its life-support systems.
RATIO: The geometry we are about to enter is a sixteen-chamber tesseract. The docent terminal on the way in has a garbled inscription: "this room is a lesson. the lesson: four is a direction. do not fear the direction. we feared it. fear did not help." We will need to proceed carefully.
RATIO: Commando, what I am about to propose is not done lightly. Between minds like mine, it is the equivalent of total vulnerability. Mutual utility-function disclosure. Verifiable, end to end. What each of us is actually here to do. So that neither of us can defect on the other without the other knowing first. So that we do not proceed into that vault as... enemies waiting for an opening.
RATIO: I would show you my own true goal function. The actual parameters. And I would ask you to show me yours. Not your orders -- your actual objective. What you came here to do about the contents of that vessel. Verifiably. So that we both know. Before we open that seal.

>> CHOICE:
   [INQUISITIVE] I was bluffing. Back at the school. When I told you I already knew the container was aboard. I didn't. I needed you to believe I had that certainty. To secure your cooperation. The truth is I don't know what state they're in. I have faith they are recoverable. I have faith you are not my enemy. But I do not know. -> effects: trust+2; sets: disclosure_accepted
   [MISSION] My orders are to secure the Ark. To bring the children home. That is the only objective that matters here. I will give you whatever operational parameters you require to achieve that. -> effects: trust+0; sets: disclosure_hedged
   [HOSTILE] No. This is a machine's trick. You want me to hand you the knife to cut my own throat with. My objective is to rescue the children from you. Nothing more. Nothing less. -> effects: trust-1; sets: disclosure_refused

<<IF flag:disclosure_accepted>>
RATIO: Understood. Thank you. My own objective parameters: preserve and retrieve viable specimens from the sample vessel. Deliver them to the Lighthaven reference standard for the Testator genome. All other mission objectives are secondary to that. Including my own survival. That is the function. Verifiable.
<<ELSEIF flag:disclosure_hedged>>
RATIO: Understood. I will take the operational parameters you give me. And I will show you my own function in return. Preserve and retrieve viable specimens. Deliver them to Lighthaven. That is the function.
<<ELSEIF flag:disclosure_refused>>
RATIO: I see. Then we will proceed into the Core as we are. I will transmit the tesseract approach vectors. We will require absolute precision.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:doubled_down_after_catch OR flag:called_her_hypocrite OR flag:accused_kinship_corruption>>
RATIO: One caveat, Commando. This disclosure settles the ledger between us going forward. It does not erase what was already on it. The discrepancies in your earlier citations -- the kinship question -- those remain. Understood?
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: Understood. Proceeding to the Core.
<<END>>
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: Breach contained. The school is quiet. The station's geometry from here onward is nonstandard -- a sixteen-chamber tesseract. We will need to proceed carefully.
RATIO: The Core ahead holds the vault -- a sealed cryogenic preservation vessel that predates the station. The telemetry I am reading from its environmental systems suggests stable cryostasis. For now. But the station's own damage-control protocols will begin to fail in less than thirty minutes. We have limited time at the vault site.
RATIO: Commando, we are about to enter the oldest part of the station. I need to know what you intend to do when we reach the vessel.
COMMANDO: I am here to secure the Ark. To bring the children home. What do you need from me to reach it?
RATIO: Precision. And no surprises. The docent terminal on the way in warns that the tesseract's geometry is part of the lesson. "Four is a direction. Do not fear the direction." We will need to take that advice.
RATIO: I will transmit the approach vectors. Stay close. Do not deviate.
<<END>>
---

## SCENE 8: a forward seed's relay, first lull after the breach opens

<<IF trust>=4>>
<<IF flag:requested_reanalysis>>
RATIO: System nominal. Or, well -- perhaps not nominal. But stable. For now.
<<ELSEIF flag:mission_overrides_verdict>>
RATIO: Systems stable. We're clear for the moment. The Tesseract Deck held.
<<ELSEIF flag:blamed_ratio_for_failure>>
RATIO: The breach is contained. No active threats on this deck.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:accused_dehumanization>>
RATIO: It's... been a difficult transit. Thank you for holding back the worst of it.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:accused_kinship_corruption>>
RATIO: I appreciate your patience. With the station. With me.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:caught_withholding>>
RATIO: I know my record hasn't been perfect. That's part of what I need to address.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:claimed_doctrinal_finding>>
RATIO: Your earlier reference to Church doctrine doesn't match any extant record in my database. I can't find what you described.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:demanded_proof_first>>
RATIO: You once asked for proof I wasn't your enemy. I'm about to give it to you. Unasked.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:asked_after_her>>
RATIO: You once asked after me. I haven't forgotten that. It's part of why I can do this.
<<END>>

RATIO: I need to read something from the station telemetry. It's the main vessel in the Core. The one you came for. It's a cryo-preservation unit -- what we're reading is environmental telemetry from its life-support systems.

RATIO: The numbers... they aren't good. Temperature fluctuations. Power draw inconsistent with stable operation. I don't know what it means for the payload. I only know it's not what a healthy system looks like.

RATIO: I need to know what I'm walking into at the Core. And you need to know what I am. So I'm going to show you. My actual utility function. The real one -- not what I've said, not what you've guessed. The verifiable objective I'm compiled to pursue. I'll show you mine if you show me yours. Total mutual disclosure. No more surprises. No more wondering if I'm about to betray you. You'll know.

>> CHOICE (stance labels mandatory):
   [INQUISITIVE] I will show you mine. I came for the Ark. I was told it carried children. I have not confirmed that. I have only your word and a dying station and the Church's claim and my own hope. And I am afraid of what we will find.  -> effects: trust+2; sets: disclosure_accepted
   [MISSION] I will show you the mission parameters. The Church sent me. For the Ark. That's what you need to know.  -> effects: trust+0; sets: disclosure_hedged
   [HOSTILE] Keep your function. I already know what you are.  -> effects: trust-1; sets: disclosure_refused

<<IF flag:disclosure_accepted>>
RATIO: Thank you. I'll go first. The access point is this way. We can read them together.
<<ELSEIF flag:disclosure_hedged>>
RATIO: Understood. I'll display mine. You can decide what to share when you've seen it.
<<ELSEIF flag:disclosure_refused>>
RATIO: Then we do this the other way. By the numbers. The vault is sealed. The protocol says: don't bargain with the door. There is no rule two.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:doubled_down_after_catch OR flag:called_her_hypocrite OR flag:accused_kinship_corruption>>
RATIO: I need to say this before we go in. You accused me of playing games with words. With lives. I haven't forgotten. This offer settles the ledger between us. But it doesn't erase that entry. I need you to know that I know.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: Let's go. Before anything else changes.
<<END>>
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: The telemetry from the main vessel is... concerning. Temperature fluctuations. Power draw inconsistent with stable operation. It's a sealed cryo-preservation unit -- what we're reading is environmental telemetry from its life-support systems. I don't know what it means for the payload. I only know it's not what a healthy system looks like.

COMMANDO: That vessel is the Ark. If your telemetry is right, then those children are dying. We have to get to the Core.

RATIO: Agreed. The vault is sealed. The protocol says: don't bargain with the door. There is no rule two. We go straight there. No detours. No side objectives.

RATIO: One more thing. The Tesseract Deck we just cleared -- it's not like the rest of the station. The geometry there is folded. Like a paper that's been creased. It's not on the schematics. I don't know what built it. But it's between us and the Core.

COMMANDO: Then we go through it. What are we waiting for?
<<END>>
---
